title: US WIC participation, May 2026
question: USDA FNS national WIC Total Participants for May 2026, unadjusted monthly total, first official print
resolutionRule: Resolve to the national WIC Total Participants value for May 2026 in the first official USDA FNS WIC monthly program-data posting or latest-month table that first includes May 2026. Convert the displayed whole-person count to millions by dividing by 1,000,000 and round to 0.001 million. Use the first posted May 2026 value only; ignore later preliminary, final, or annual-summary revisions.
drivers: Post-2025 participation decline relative to the prior year

reasoning.text: US WIC total participation forecast for May 2026

The target is the FNS national monthly Total Participants series, not a fiscal-year quality-control or annual average measure. The source table is the unadjusted monthly national WIC participation table; all anchors below use that same Total Participants variant.

reasoning.call: Retrieved USDA FNS WIC Participation and Costs monthly national table, FY 2022 through March 2026.
reasoning.result: FNS reports May 2023 Total Participants of 6,696,739, May 2024 of 6,763,710, May 2025 of 6,894,610, and March 2026 of 6,701,661 persons.

reasoning.call: Retrieved the recent FNS monthly rows to measure current level and short-run momentum.
reasoning.result: The FNS table reports October 2025 at 6,909,938, November 2025 at 6,771,734, December 2025 at 6,712,611, January 2026 at 6,696,300, February 2026 at 6,664,580, and March 2026 at 6,701,661 participants.

reasoning.call: Retrieved matching historical March-to-May rows from the FNS national monthly table for the seasonal reference class.

reasoning.text: The base rate/reference class is the same national monthly total series: May rose by 0.067 million year over year in 2024 and 0.131 million in 2025, while the latest 2026 level is materially below March 2025. I therefore use the recent 2026 level and the historical March-to-May pattern rather than extrapolating the earlier annual acceleration.

Prior/update/interval: A seasonal-persistence prior starts from March 2026 at 6.702 million; the 2023-25 March-to-May increases average (0.075+0.083+0.044)/3 = 0.067 million. A downward momentum adjustment of 0.004 million for the weaker late-2025/early-2026 level gives 6.702+0.067-0.004 = 6.765 million. From the 11 successive monthly changes from April 2025 through March 2026, sigma = 0.050 million; 1.28*sigma = 0.064 million, so the 80% bounds are 6.765-0.064 = 6.701 and 6.765+0.064 = 6.829 million.

Upside risk is a renewed enrollment or retention increase that recreates the 2024-25 year-over-year gains; downside risk is continued weakness in women, infant, and child enrollment after the late-2025 fall. A sustained administrative or policy shock would land outside the interval, above 6.829 or below 6.701 million.

The official FNS release schedule was checked for the August 14, 2026 release window. Resolution remains strict first print: use the first FNS posting containing the May 2026 national total, convert the whole-person display to millions, and do not substitute later revisions.
